t: Flomasta PipeGrip Reducing Elbow is a push-fit water pipe fitting designed to reduce 15mm pipe to 10mm in a 90° turn. Its dual locking system and green band indicator ensure a secure, leak-free connection with no hot works required. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for adapting pipe size and routing pipework in tight spaces.
